title: Carne Asada Vampiro Tacos
reject_reason: Marinated sirloin carne asada in a tortiy with salsa is the same carne asada dinner already double-covered by live carne-asada-burrito and slow-cooker-carne-asada-rice-bowls; the vampiro/taco format is a re-plating that deepens a dense lane rather than a new dinner.
